recommendations.name: Dash0 AutoMerge
recommendations.description: An observability platform whose AutoMerge agent scores each GitHub or GitLab PR for risk (blast radius, evidence quality, change footprint) and approves or merges the low-risk ones, with dry-run, auto-approve and auto-merge modes.

recommendations.name: Cursor PR Routing & Approval (approval agents)
recommendations.description: Not an observability platform, but it classifies PR risk and can auto-approve PRs below a maximum risk level you set, with policy files and Bugbot/security checks as gates (GitHub only).

recommendations.name: Renovate automerge
recommendations.description: Not an observability platform, but a widely used dependency-update bot whose automerge setting merges low-risk update PRs once your checks pass.
